not_selected_notes.spine_frozen_bias: Strong mean but large seed spread; prioritize distinct rank/freezing and basis mechanisms within four-family budget. Not evidence that bias cannot improve long training.
not_selected_notes.spine_frozen_gain: Consistent short improvement; deferred for mechanism coverage because fixed geometry is already represented by rank4 and full46.
not_selected_notes.spine_rank2: Rank1 has stronger mean across paired implementation cohorts; rank4 frozen adds a distinct trainability question. No assertion rank2 would lose at 100k.
not_selected_notes.spine_rank4_fused_repeat: Avoid allocating two of four families to closely related learned rank sweeps; rank1 selected with implementation-averaged score.
not_selected_notes.full_rank1: Only two of three seed wins and weaker mean than selected scalar spine; does not warrant replacing another mechanism.
not_selected_notes.spine_rank1_frozen: Two of three seed wins and weaker mean than frozen rank4; rank1 learned remains selected.
not_selected_notes.original_equation_family: All four original/sigmoid geometry interventions have worse three-seed means than fixed MLP; no long follow-up within remaining time.

remaining_candidates: Retained in full ranking and reserved evaluation; not selected because their short mean was weaker or mechanism overlaps selected families. Short ranking is not proof of long-run ordering.
